title: sc-import-design manifest
description: Where an export lands, where tokens live, and the fail-closed gates it must pass. hard_blocks is required: an import that can skip its blocks is not gated.

scratch_dir.description: Gitignored staging OUTSIDE the repository, so a rejected import leaves nothing behind.

token_sot.description: Single source of truth for design tokens. Never inline a literal.

hard_blocks.description: Fail-closed gates. All must pass before anything enters the repository.
